targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP (1) query_id, query_hash_hex, query_text_preview FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id} ORDER BY period_end_utc DESC
SELECT SUM(execution_count) executions FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id}
SELECT SUM(total_cpu_ms) total_cpu_ms FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id}
SELECT SUM(total_duration_ms) total_duration_ms FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id}
SELECT SUM(total_logical_reads) total_logical_reads FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id}
SELECT COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT query_plan_hash_hex) plans_observed FROM qv_report.query_plans WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id}
SELECT SUM(total_wait_ms) total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.query_wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id}

SELECT period_end_utc AS time, execution_count, total_cpu_ms, total_duration_ms, total_logical_reads FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id} ORDER BY period_end_utc

SELECT wait_category_desc AS metric, SUM(total_wait_ms) AS value FROM qv_report.query_wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id} GROUP BY wait_category_desc ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT period_id, plan_id, query_plan_hash_hex, engine_version, compatibility_level, is_parallel_plan, is_forced_plan, is_trivial_plan, plan_type_desc, last_execution_time FROM qv_report.query_plans WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) AND query_id = ${query_id} ORDER BY period_id DESC, plan_id

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT source_server_name AS __text, source_server_name AS __value FROM qv_report.periods ORDER BY source_server_name
list.label: Source server
list.name: source_server
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_server_name AS __text, source_server_name AS __value FROM qv_report.periods ORDER BY source_server_name

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT source_database_name AS __text, source_database_name AS __value FROM qv_report.periods WHERE source_server_name = ${source_server:sqlstring} ORDER BY source_database_name
list.label: Source database
list.name: source_database
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_database_name AS __text, source_database_name AS __value FROM qv_report.periods WHERE source_server_name = ${source_server:sqlstring} ORDER BY source_database_name

list.definition: SELECT CONCAT(period_name, ' | ', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), period_start_utc, 120), ' - ', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), period_end_utc, 120)) AS __text, CAST(period_id AS VARCHAR(20)) AS __value FROM qv_report.periods WHERE source_server_name = ${source_server:sqlstring} AND source_database_name = ${source_database:sqlstring} AND period_status = 'Completed' ORDER BY period_end_utc DESC
list.label: Archived periods
list.name: archived_period
list.query: SELECT CONCAT(period_name, ' | ', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), period_start_utc, 120), ' - ', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), period_end_utc, 120)) AS __text, CAST(period_id AS VARCHAR(20)) AS __value FROM qv_report.periods WHERE source_server_name = ${source_server:sqlstring} AND source_database_name = ${source_database:sqlstring} AND period_status = 'Completed' ORDER BY period_end_utc DESC

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('Query ', query_id, ' | ', LEFT(query_text_preview, 120)) AS __text, CAST(query_id AS VARCHAR(20)) AS __value FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) ORDER BY __text
list.label: Query
list.name: query_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('Query ', query_id, ' | ', LEFT(query_text_preview, 120)) AS __text, CAST(query_id AS VARCHAR(20)) AS __value FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id IN (${archived_period:csv}) ORDER BY __text
